LACSON: PHOTO INTENDED TO DISCREDIT BLUE RIBBON PROBE ON FLOOD CONTROL MESS

Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson on Wednesday dismissed an old photo showing him with flood-control contractors Curlee and Sarah Discaya, calling it an attempt to discredit his chairmanship of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee's probe into anomalous projects.

Lacson clarified that the picture was taken during the 2025 campaign period, when the couple joined a courtesy visit arranged by a Davao-based supporter, Fred Villaroman, in his Taguig office. Villaroman is the son of the late P/Brig. Gen. Francisco Villaroman, who had previously served under Lacson in the police force.

According to Lacson, the meeting lasted only 15 to 20 minutes, during which he was invited to a rally of the Pinoy Ako party-list group, where the Discayas' son was a nominee. Also present at the meeting were Cezarah and Pacifico Discaya II.

He said he declined the invitation out of respect for Senate President Tito Sotto, whose nephew Vico was running for reelection as Pasig City mayor against Mrs. Discaya. Lacson added that he also avoided partisan rallies of party-list groups to maintain political prudence.

The senator further denied having any financial ties with the Discayas.

"I did not receive, nor did the Discayas offer any campaign contribution in whatever form," he said.

"The fact that it is being circulated only means that it intended to besmirch my reputation and credibility in chairing the Blue Ribbon Committee on the flood control project anomalies," Lacson added.

The most powerful storm on earth in 2025 is RAGING near the Philippines right now! Super Typhoon Ragasa is at maximum intensity category 5 with data suggesting wind gusts as high as 330km/h today (inset). The core of the system is extremely deadly which will track West near Northern Luzon this afternoon & tonight with destructive winds, heavy rainfall & flooding. Sadly there are numerous islands in Luzon Strait that will be directly run over by this beast which are likely to experience complete destruction. 
Hong Kong and Macao could be directly impacted by this super typhoon on Wednesday with forecast data suggesting the system could maintain most of its strength across the South China Sea. The exact track will become critical over the next 48hrs for the 2 cities with heavy rainfall, flooding and destructive winds up to 250km/h being possible.
🙏🏻🩵

🇵🇭 DEADLY 6.9 EARTHQUAKE ROCKS PHILIPPINES - DOZENS KILLED

A massive quake hit off Cebu province, collapsing homes, roads, and public buildings across the central Philippines.

At least 69 are dead - including 14 in Bogo, buried by a landslide, and 12 in Medellin town, who were crushed as homes gave way.

Rescue teams are battling blackouts, broken roads, and cut-off villages as aftershocks loom.

Source: The Independent
